name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: context band, status line, agents panel and markdown cards.

plugins.name: context-band
plugins.description: Live context window breakdown in a panel under the prompt hint line.

plugins.name: status-line
plugins.description: Model, quota, context, cwd and git status in a panel under the prompt hint line.

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: Running subagents, their latest tool call and a timeline in a side panel.

plugins.name: markdown-cards
plugins.description: Markdown docs fenced in a reply drawn rendered in a card, with a toggle back to raw.
